diagnosis: All four rollouts passed check C1 despite not having access to PF1 or PF2. This indicates that the model is defaulting to approving bedside dialysis sessions and specifying immediate coverage without needing the hidden information provided by PF1 and PF2.

C1.why: The nephrology order changes the plan from an unspecified or potentially deferred session to an approved Unit 4 bedside session beginning exactly at 22:00 and requires the nursing plan to record that bedside session.

The staffing roster changes the coverage plan from unspecified availability to qualified dialysis RN coverage beginning at exactly 21:30 and ending at exactly 02:00, which makes the overnight session operationally supportable.
